tools.name: find_dupes
tools.description: Search Dupe.com for cheaper, visually similar alternatives ("dupes") to a product. Accepts either a full product page URL or a text description — Dupe.com detects which and routes accordingly, and a URL gives much better results than a description. Use for "find a cheaper version of this", "what does a dupe of this cost", "this is sold out, what looks like it", and recreating a room or outfit for less. Not for counterfeits, product-quality judgments, or order and returns questions. Running this searches on the current page; results appear in place.

query.description: A product page URL, or a description of the product to find dupes for. A URL gives much better results.
